info.title: Ondo Perps REST API
info.description: REST API for Ondo Perps: account, wallet, deposits/withdrawals, API keys, and perpetual futures trading.

fillVolume.description: Cumulative fill volume at this time

netQuantity.description: Size of the position in base currency

liquidationPrice.description: Price at which the position will be liquidated

bankruptcyPrice.description: Price at which bankruptcy occurs during liquidation

maintenanceMargin.description: Maintenance margin required for this position

leverage.description: Current effective leverage for this position

netFundingSinceNeutral.description: Net funding payments since the position was opened

returnOnEquity.description: Return on equity for this position

stopLossTriggerPrice.description: Triggering price for stop loss order (optional)

takeProfitTriggerPrice.description: Triggering price for take profit order (optional)

walletBalance.description: The amount in USDC resulting from transfers in/out, realized PnL, and fees. wallet_balance = deposits - withdrawals + realized_pnl + trading_fees + funding_rate_fees

unrealizedPnl.description: The current unrealized PNL in USDC at mark price for open positions

marginBalance.description: Margin balance in USDC. margin_balance = wallet_balance + unrealized_pnl

usedMargin.description: Amount of used margin in USDC for resting orders and positions. used_margin = sum_for_all_markets(max(position_ask + resting_orders_ask, position_bid + resting_orders_bid) + open_loss_total)

availableMargin.description: Amount of margin in USDC available for new positions. available_balance = margin_balance - used_margin. Will not be negative.

withdrawableMargin.description: Amount in USDC available for withdrawal. withdrawable_amount = max(0, min(available_balance, wallet_balance))

maintenanceMarginRequirement.description: Total maintenance margin requirement for all open positions

totalMaintenanceMargin.description: Total maintenance margin requirement for all open positions and resting orders

marginRatio.description: Margin ratio (0–100%) indicating liquidation proximity. margin_ratio = maintenance_margin / margin_balance. Returns 9999 if margin balance is negative or zero.

leverage.description: Effective leverage for the entire account (notional value of all positions / margin balance)

underLiquidation.description: Whether the account is currently under liquidation

totalFundingPayments.description: Sum of all funding payments applied to this account

totalTradingFees.description: Sum of all trading fees paid. A negative value implies a net rebate.

totalPnL.description: All-time PnL including realized/unrealized PnL, fees, and funding payments

maxBidBaseSize.description: Allowed buy order size in base asset

maxAskBaseSize.description: Allowed ask order size in base asset

time.description: Time of the mark price measurement

market.description: The market the funding rate applies to

time.description: Time of the premium index measurement

fundingRate.description: The funding rate as a fraction

orders.description: Array of order requests. Must have at least 1 element and at most 20.
